The accused in this case was arraigned before the S.S.D.Court on the forenoon of 28/3/34 when application for a Writ of Detention, pending the production of the necessary evidence to facilitate his extradition to the jurisdiction of the Chinese Authorities. After hearing the evidence however, the Presiding Judge made an order that the accused be released on security, this being furnished by his employers, the Yoong Tsing Law Office, 304 Peking Road.

In the intervening period the accused has been further questioned by the undersigned and D.S.I.Golder of the Special Branch regarding the allegations made against him, but he continues to deny all connection with the Communist Party, and has divulged nothing which would incriminate himself in any way. Proceedings. Mr Chang :- In this case the Police ask for the detention

only, the P.S.B. ask that the accused be handed over. I oppose this
however until such time as they can establish a Prima Facie case
in this court. Meantime I ask that the case be remanded to enable
the P.S.B. so to do. I have no objection to the accused being re-
leased upon furnishing security.

Pau Ts Zui (保子如)
Nantung D.S.I. Gendar
H'Kew Stn. March 27, 1934. Clerk Zung Zo ng Oen

My name is Pau Ts Zui, aged 27, native of Nantung, Northern Kiangsu. I was born in the country near Nantung where my father had a position as a shop-assistant in a Chinese sauce shop. From the age of 8 to 14, I studied in the Zung Poh(城北) High Primary School in Nantung. Upon the death of my father 13 years ago I left home and went to the town of Er Chah (二甲) near Nantung where I obtained a position as a shop-assistant in a cloth shop. I remained there until September 1931 when owing to bad business I lost my position. In October 1931 I came to Shanghai at the instance of the son of my former employer one named Zung Tseu Tsoong (陈守中) who is a member of the executive staff of the Chinese Manufacturers' Association (机联会), No. 383 Ningpo Road. Zung introduced me to a man named Chang Kao Hwo (蒋观华) who was at that time employed in the Sz Sz Sing Pao (時事新報 Modern News) Shantung Road. Chang Koo Hwo in turn introduced me to Tsang Tso Bing (张竹平), the owner-operator of the Sung Sze (申時) Telegraphic News Agency which is situated in the offices of the China Press, 36 Szechuen Road. Upon arrival in Shanghai, subsequent to obtaining the job in the news agency, I went to live in the dormitory provided for single employees of the company, situated in the Tseu Ching Li (慈錦里), Kinkiang Road. In October, 1932, I was forced to leave the Sung Sze News Agency owing to reduction of staff. Within a few days of losing my berth, I found work as a clerk with Yeu Kau ( ), a lawyer, whose offices are situated at NO. 504 Peking Road where I am still

江苏南通人。侦探督察。
虹口巡捕房。1934年3月27日。书记员 Zung Zo ng Oen（原文不清）

我叫保子如，27岁，籍贯江苏北部南通。我出生在南通附近的乡村，父亲在当地一家中式酱园担任店员。8岁至14岁时，我在南通的城北高等小学读书。13年前父亲去世后，我离家前往南通附近的二甲镇，在一家布店谋得店员职位。我一直在那里工作到1931年9月，因生意不佳而失业。1931年10月，在我前雇主的儿子陈守中（Zung Tseu Tsoong）的引荐下，我来到上海。陈守中是宁波路383号中国国货维持会（机联会）的执行职员。陈守中将我介绍给蒋观华（Chang Kao Hwo），蒋当时受雇于山东路的《时事新报》（Sz Sz Sing Pao / Modern News）。蒋观华又将我介绍给张竹平（Tsang Tso Bing），他是申时电讯社（Sung Sze Telegraphic News Agency）的业主兼经营者，该社位于四川路36号的《China Press》报社办公室内。抵沪并在电讯社获得职位后，我搬入公司为单身员工提供的宿舍，位于金陵路慈锦里。1932年10月，由于裁员，我被迫离开申时电讯社。失业后几天内，我在北京路504号找到了一份律师尤某（Yeu Kau，原文括号内为空）事务所的书记员工作，我至今仍

Upon obtaining my new position I went to live at No. 937
Tah Lai Faung (泰來坊) off Gordon Road where I remained
until June 1933 when I removed to No. 18 Hung Ching Li
(恒慶里), Tiendong Road. After residing there for two
months I removed to the house where I was arrested - No. 73
South Tiendong Road.
I was married about four years ago to a girl named Lau
(趙) from my native place. She returned to her home in
Nantung on February 27 owing to the illness of my mother.
Since March 15, 1934, I have been laid up in my room
at No. 73 South Tiendong Road with an ulcerated leg.
You tell me that I am arrested as a Communist. I wish
to state that I have never been a member of the party nor
professed leanings towards it.
(Signed) Pau Ts Zui.

自1934年3月15日起，我因腿部溃疡一直卧病在天潼路73号的房间内。
你告知我因涉嫌共产党分子而被捕。我要声明，我从未加入过该党，也未表达过对该党的倾向。
